verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a robot simulator that offers multiple high-performance physics engines (ODE, Bullet, DART) through Gazebo Physics. It also ships ready-made robots (PR2, TurtleBot, etc.), physically accurate environment models via Gazebo Fuel, and example SDF worlds you can copy and modify. Sensor support is evidenced only through custom plugins for robot, sensor, and environment control. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of built-in sensor models (cameras, lidar, IMU, noise models), evidence on physics fidelity, and independent or hands-on corroboration of realism.
